card.name: Count words before "times"
card.fires_on: A count word such as three, several or 3 (or "at") placed right before "times" or "days" to give how often something happens, such as three times a week.

modes.label: Dose frequency
modes.description: A number word before "times" in a dosing schedule, such as three times weekly or daily.
modes.example: the dose can be decreased to 1 mcg<< three>> times a week.

modes.label: General frequency
modes.description: A count word or "at" before "times" in ordinary prose to say how often something occurs.
modes.example: but he made the team and pitched well<< at>> times.

card.writes: It promotes words that mean sometimes or often and suppresses words about frequency, so the text continues with "times" instead.
card.plain: It spots the number word in phrases like "three times a week" just before the word "times" comes next.
